mapper.insert: insert into admin_accounts(username, password_hash, status) values (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, 'ACTIVE')
insert into admin_sessions(admin_id, token_hash, expires_at) values (#{adminId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: select s.admin_id, a.username, s.last_seen_at from admin_sessions s join admin_accounts a on a.id = s.admin_id where s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} and s.revoked_at is null and s.expires_at > #{now} and a.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update admin_sessions set last_seen_at = #{now} where token_hash = #{tokenHash}
update admin_accounts set last_login_at = #{now} where id = #{adminId}
mapper.insert: insert into admin_audit_logs(admin_id, action, target_type, target_id, summary, ip_address) values (#{adminId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{summary}, #{ipAddress})
